fixed_dimensions.direction_policy: one fixed directed edge per monetary pair in v1
fixed_dimensions.seed_environment_jitter: sha256(world:{shock}:{seed}) mod 3 ticks, applied identically to every treatment cell sharing shock and seed

estimands.definition: Mean(metric | pair, adapter, shock) - Mean(metric | pair, absent, shock).
Mean(metric | pair, adapter, shock) - Mean(metric | pair, adapter, normal).
Difference-in-differences between the adapter effect under shock and normal conditions.
Balanced difference in a metric between monetary-pair levels under the same adapter, shock and seed design; no universal pair ranking.
Exact trace identity is compared by trace digest; metric equivalence is a separate observable relation.

measurement_semantics.completion_time: Defined only for runs reaching externally_finalized; incomplete runs remain null rather than being censored into a duration.
measurement_semantics.technical_settlement_time: Adapter-declared technical settlement duration only; operational workflow time is excluded.
measurement_semantics.operational_waiting_time: end_to_end_completion_time minus technical_settlement_time for completed runs.
measurement_semantics.reconciliation_backlog: Count of reconciliation items created by the workflow; not a latency measure.
measurement_semantics.trace_binding: Each observation binds scenario_id, policy_digest, settlement_receipt_digest, seed, edge_digest and trace_digest.
measurement_semantics.seed_binding: Seed controls only exogenous world jitter through the explicit treatment-independent random namespace.

claim_ceiling: Synthetic balanced factorial only; identifies contrasts inside this declared model. It does not establish empirical causality, macroeconomic superiority, legal interoperability, solvency, market liquidity, policy desirability, or live-system safety.
